title: GH #144: a stale provisional pick file on a final-skip day could be delivered by the fallback and scored by check-results or result polling
tier_reason: the defect class reaches delivery (the fallback delivered the cached provisional pick on a genuine skip) and local streak state (check-results / result polling scored a non-committed pick); two accepted private-mode residuals reached production once delivery went private on 9/14

contract.text: A genuine MDP skip day delivers nothing, is never locked for result polling and changes no streak state; only a committed pick (delivered, private_locked or locked_unconfirmed) may be scored — a provisional <date>.json (3am preview or pre-lock candidate save) is never delivered, polled or scored on a skip day.

mechanism.text: bts check-results (01:00 cron) scored whatever load_pick(date) returned, gated only on 'already resolved', so a stale provisional <date>.json on a final-skip day would be scored and the streak updated from a pick production never made

run_day's result-polling block was gated only on state.pick_locked; a non-delivered classification-lock of the stale file (game start / status failure) set pick_locked, and run_result_polling -> update_streak scored it with no internal scoreable guard
the fallback re-evaluated at its deadline, got pick_result None (a genuine MDP skip) and, treating it as 'no fresh pick, use cached', delivered and locked the stale provisional pick

three checks read an undelivered pick file as a failure on a deliberate-skip day — the E3 missed-pick alert, the EOD post_failure CRITICAL and analytics_artifacts_missing (pick_locked-or-delivered heuristic) — so a correctly undelivered file raises false alerts

verified_recovered.how: first live projected-pick→real-skip flip (7/01): the stale provisional file was still result-less on 7/02 after the 01:00 scoring run ('no scorer will ever fill it (correctly)')
7/01 flip: the stale provisional file was never delivered — the day finalized as an MDP skip (decision.json action=skip) with the file undelivered

residual.text: Accepted private-mode edges: a private pick whose best-effort decision.json write fails goes unscored, and a private pick is not re-locked on a restart before first pitch; production delivery was private from 9/14.
residual.source: ARCHITECTURE.md 'Daemon-path completion' (5d2bf39); delivery axis (pick_delivery = private from 9/14)

residual.text: By design the fallback's cascade-error safety net still delivers the cached provisional pick when no standing skip is known yet, so a cascade failure on a day that confirmed lineups would have turned into a skip can deliver that provisional pick.

watchdog.trigger: after the 01:00 check-results run and after any result-polling write: a date whose pick file gained a result, or whose streak.json changed, while its decision.json is absent or scoreable=false and the pick file has no delivery record (notification_sent / bluesky_posted / delivered_at); separately, any delivery record on a date whose decision.json action is skip
watchdog.recovery_assertion: for every final-skip date the pick file stays result-less, streak.json is unchanged by that date and no delivery exists; a violation is reverted and alerted

evidence.what: found during the skip-policy shadow work and deferred as tracked: 'a pre-existing check-results bug — it scores undelivered preview/provisional picks on skip days, corrupting the streak'
check-results scores whatever load_pick(date) returns, gated only on 'already resolved'; production has no single authoritative record of its final decision (GH #144)

result polling gated only on state.pick_locked; a non-delivered classification-lock of a stale projected preview sets pick_locked on an MDP-skip day and run_result_polling -> update_streak scores it (C2)
on the projected→real flip the fallback got pick_result None (a real skip) and, treating it as 'no fresh pick, use cached', delivered + locked + scored the stale preview (C1)
_maybe_alert_missed_pick, post_failure.check and analytics_artifacts_missing read an undelivered pick file as a failure on skip days (D6)
